## AAC Admin Command Boundary

Private webhook called only by the Cloudflare Worker. Attach a Header Auth credential that validates `X-AAC-Admin-Secret`, plus the existing BigQuery credential. Commands are idempotent, state-checked, and audited before n8n continues orchestration.

Activating this workflow enables actions that can send invitations or advance approved content. Test with a test campaign before production use.
